goal.note: All 20 programs build muscle. Your goal determines session length — not a different program.

options.label: Build muscle & gain strength
options.description: Fully optimised version — more volume, 60–90 min sessions

options.label: Build muscle (limited time)
options.description: Time-efficient version — same results, 45–60 min sessions

options.label: Lose fat while maintaining muscle
options.description: Same training as muscle-building. Fat loss is driven by diet.

options.label: Body recomposition
options.description: Lose fat and gain muscle simultaneously — same training, adjust nutrition.

experience.bot_message: What is your training experience level?
experience.note: Based on years of serious, consistent training — not just time spent in a gym casually.

options.label: Beginner
options.description: Under ~1 year of serious training. You make strength progress workout to workout.

options.label: Intermediate
options.description: 2–5 years of serious training. Progress happens week to week.

options.label: Advanced
options.description: 5–10 years of serious training. Progress happens over months.

days.bot_message: How many days per week can you consistently train?
days.note: A lower frequency you can stick to is always better than a higher one you can't.

equipment.bot_message: What equipment do you have access to?
equipment.note: Every exercise in every program has substitution options. Equipment affects exercise selection, not which program you follow.

options.label: Full commercial gym
options.description: Barbells, dumbbells, cables, machines — all 20 programs available

options.label: Home gym
options.description: Barbell, dumbbells, rack and bench — all splits still work

options.label: Dumbbells only
options.description: Home or limited gym — full-body splits work best

options.label: Bodyweight only
options.description: Works at beginner level — progressions will be limited without added resistance

split.bot_message: Do you have a preferred training split?
split.note: This only matters if your other answers result in a tie between 2 equally good programs. If you have no preference, select the last option.

options.label: Full Body
options.description: Every session trains all major muscle groups. Best for beginners and those who want flexibility — missing a session doesn't leave a muscle untrained.

options.label: Upper / Lower
options.description: Alternates upper and lower body days. A clean, popular split for intermediate lifters at 4–6 days/week.

options.label: Push / Pull / Legs (PPL)
options.description: Push, Pull, Legs days — cycled twice over 6 days. Focused sessions with clear muscle group separation.

options.label: Hybrid (Upper/Lower + PPL)
options.description: Combines Upper/Lower and PPL across 5 days. Great for intermediate+ lifters wanting structure with variety.

options.label: No preference — just recommend one
options.description: We'll pick the best fit based on your other answers. Both tied programs are equally effective.

schedule.bot_message: Which days work best for you?
